format: html

#import file

```{r}
#make sure you set the folder where your file is saved as the current working directory
#check whether the excel file names are the same and don't change the dataframe name
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

#Put in file names
BZB_90min <- read_excel("10_27_overnight_data_cleaned.xlsx", sheet="first")
BZB_overnight <- read_excel("10_27_overnight_data_cleaned.xlsx", sheet="second")
```

#clean and combine

```{r}
BZB_90min$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(BZB_90min$"Cycle Nr.")

BZB_overnight$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(BZB_overnight$"Cycle Nr.")
```

```{r}
BZB_overnight$"Cycle Nr." <- BZB_overnight$"Cycle Nr." + 90
```

```{r}
BZB_overnight$Time_s <- BZB_overnight$Time_s + 5400

```

```{r}
combined_df <- bind_rows(BZB_90min, BZB_overnight)
```

```{r}
#preserve both cycle nr. and time
pivoted_OD <- combined_df %>%
pivot_longer(cols = -c(1,2), names_to = "well_ID", values_to = "OD")
```

```{r}
#change Time [s] to Time [h]
df_clean <- pivoted_OD%>%
  mutate(Time_min=round(Time_s/60,1),
         Time_h=round(Time_min/60,1))%>%
  rename(Cycle=`Cycle Nr.`)%>%
  select(Cycle, Time_h, Time_min, everything())
  
```

#make a key col

```{r}
df_clean$well_ID_Copy <- df_clean$well_ID

df_clean<-df_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols = well_ID_Copy,
    delim = "_",
    names = c("well", "BZB_conc", "type")
  )

df_clean<- df_clean %>%
  mutate(numeric_conc = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", BZB_conc)))

df_clean$numeric_conc <- factor(df_clean$numeric_conc)
```



#calculate mean from replicates

```{r}
df_summarise <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Time_h, BZB_conc, numeric_conc) %>%
  summarise(
    min=min(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    max=max(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(CV = sd/mean)

```

#plot curves

```{r}
BZB_curve<- df_summarise |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = Time_h, y = mean, color = numeric_conc)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max, color = cipro_ug_mL, group =cipro_ug_mL), width = 0.2)+
   labs(title = "BZB Overnight Growth Curve 10.27",
        y="Mean OD",
        color="BZB volume (uL/well)",
        caption="NA is the LB-only Control")

BZB_curve

#check working directory before saving!
ggsave("./Plots/BZB Overnight Growth Curve 102726.png", plot = BZB_curve, width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
